Lett. 136, 211401 – Published 26 May, 2026 DOI: https://doi.org/10.1103/mtqm-xz2k Export Citation Show metrics Abstract We construct a novel effective field theory for a compact body coupled to gravity, whose key feature is that the dynamics of gravitational perturbations is explicitly determined by known solutions in black hole perturbation theory in four dimensions.
